definitions.short: Bani , the name of five Israelites
definitions.full: H1137. Bani בָּנִי proper name, masculine 1. one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:36 הַגָּדִי בָּנִי (|| 1Chr 11:38 has בֶּןהַֿגְרִי , but see Dr Sm ). 2 Levites , a. 1Chr 6:31 ; b. Neh 3:17 ; compare 8:7 (= בִּנּוּי 10:10 ) 9:4 (twice in verse) (repeated probably by error, compare BeRy) 9:5 ; 10:14 ; 11:22 . On Ezra 2:40 = Neh 7:43 compare Gr Geschichte.ii.2, 389 ; he reads בני קדמיאל for לבני קדמיאל , taking בני as proper name, as 3 Ezra 5:26 Καδμιηλου καὶ Βαννου . 3 a man of Judah 1Chr 9:4 ( מִן ) בָּנִי Qr ( > Kt בנימן ). 4 Ezra 2:10 read בִּנּוּי compare || Neh 7:15 . 5 heads of families of Isr . a. Ezra 10:29 ; b. Neh 10:15 ; c. Ezra 10:34 but perhaps read בִּנּוּי or בִּגְּוַי compare above 6 an Israelite Ezra 10:38 . — ( בני as proper name Palmyrene Vog No. 94 .)
